result.brief: 提出 LabInstruct 基准，用于真实实验室场景下的指令驱动视频生成，含 204 个任务与物体、动作、接触、状态转移的结构化标注，并评测 8 个前沿图生视频模型，揭示视觉逼真与流程正确性的差距。
result.reason: Benchmark for image-to-video instructional generation with structured annotations of actions, contacts and state transitions; evaluates 8 frontier I2V models, directly serving video generation evaluation.
